objective: distinguish exact-accepted comparable filing deterioration from price damage without reusing a rejected source signal as an action gate

statuses.CONFIRMED_EXACT_ACCEPTED_BREAK: negative comparable filing and all confirmation gates pass
statuses.NEGATIVE_EXACT_FILING_REVIEW_ONLY: negative comparable filing exists but source validation or archive-coverage gate is closed
statuses.NO_EXACT_BREAK_EVIDENCE: latest comparable filing is nonnegative or unavailable
